research.notes: A grocery store named Skyline Community Market exists at 11881 Skyline Blvd, Oakland, CA 94619, but it appears only on third-party directory listings (Yelp, Apple Maps, etc.). No official website, no California Secretary of State or other registry record, and no page linking it to OUSD's workplace training partnership were found, so the match to the agenda vendor could not be confirmed with two independent signals.
